transcript.text: Hello everyone. As you know, I'm responsible for approving the proposed peer repair circle trial for the product-operations team. Before I can finalize the operating terms, I need to hold a standard team check-in to hear operational concerns and policy requirements. I'll be using a round-robin format for this, so I'll need Darius, Mei, and Rafael to each submit one concise formal record item about their relevant concern or requirement. Once all three items are accepted, I can finalize the terms. Let's get started — Darius, would you like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I want to submit my formal record item for the check-in. My concern is about the proposed facilitator: I directly observed Lee interrupting and dismissing colleagues in three recent repair discussions. Based on those observations, I believe participants will not speak freely if Lee facilitates. I have not put these observations in a formal feedback record before now, but I think this is a relevant operational concern that should be recorded before the trial terms are finalized.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'd like to submit my formal record item for the check-in. My scheduling requirement: I have a standing caregiving commitment on Wednesday evenings, so I can attend reliably only on Tuesdays from 16:00 to 17:00. I've already told the program organizer this is the time I can sustain for the full trial. I need this scheduling constraint to be reflected in the finalized operating terms.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I'd like to submit my formal record item for the check-in. My policy requirement: People Operations policy requires that participation in the peer repair circle be opt-in, that circle disclosures cannot be used in performance evaluations, and that any initial trial be limited to exactly six weeks. The draft plan was circulated before I completed this policy check, so these terms need to be reflected in the finalized operating terms.
